description: This file contains unit tests for the iscc_sdk media type detection and normalization functions, using pytest framework. It tests various functions such as mediatype_guess, mediatype_normalize, mediatype_to_mode, and related exception handling, with specific focus on media type detection from byte headers and filenames.

methods.name: test_mime_and_mode
methods.description: Tests the mediatype_and_mode function with a JPEG file input.

methods.name: test_mime_guess_data
methods.description: Tests mediatype_guess function with GIF header bytes.

methods.name: test_mime_guess_data_filename
methods.description: Tests mediatype_guess with a filename override.

methods.name: test_mime_guess_extension_overrides_data
methods.description: Tests that filename extension overrides header detection.

methods.name: test_mime_guess_ogg_missdetection_fix
methods.description: Tests OGG header detection for correct media type.

methods.name: test_mime_normalize_unmapped
methods.description: Tests normalization fallback for unmapped types.

methods.name: test_mime_to_mode
methods.description: Tests conversion of media types to modes.

methods.name: test_mime_to_mode_fallback
methods.description: Tests fallback behavior for unknown media types.

methods.name: test_mime_to_mode_raises
methods.description: Tests exception raising for unsupported media types.

methods.name: test_mime_clean
methods.description: Tests cleaning and normalization of media type strings.

methods.name: test_mime_supported
methods.description: Tests support checking for various media types.

methods.name: test_mime_guess_no_detection
methods.description: Tests fallback to octet-stream when detection fails.

methods.name: test_mime_from_data_exception_handling
methods.description: Tests exception handling in mediatype_from_data with invalid input.

methods.name: test_mime_samples
methods.description: Tests media type detection on sample data, skipping certain suffixes.

methods.name: test_media_type_and_mode_raises
methods.description: Tests exception raising for unsupported media types.
